title: vaximile pipeline parameters
description: Tumor neoantigen discovery using paired tumour-normal bulk DNA and RNA sequencing

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

samplesheet.description: Path to comma-separated file describing the patients, samples and FastQ files.

capture_kits.description: Path to comma-separated file mapping capture kit names to their BED target files.

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved.

reference_genome_options.title: Reference genome options
reference_genome_options.description: Reference genome, annotation and transcriptome files.

reference_fa.description: Reference genome FASTA. Gzipped input is decompressed and indexed automatically.

reference_includes_chr_prefix.description: Set to false when the reference contigs are named without a 'chr' prefix.

gtf.description: Gene annotation GTF used for RNA alignment, quantification and fusion calling.

transcriptome_reference.description: Transcriptome FASTA used to build the salmon index.

human_ref_peptides.description: Reference proteome peptide FASTA used by pVACtools for reference proteome similarity.

alignment_index_options.title: Alignment index options
alignment_index_options.description: Prebuilt indices. Any left unset are built from the reference during the run.

bwa_index.description: Directory containing a prebuilt minibwa index. When not given, the index is built and saved to vaximile_resources/bwa_index/ in the launch directory.
bwa_index.help_text: Must hold the two files minibwa writes (.l2b, .mbw), named after the *prepared* reference FASTA, i.e. '<reference_fa stem>_prc.fa.<ext>'. minibwa is given the reference FASTA as its index prefix, so an index built from a differently named FASTA will not be found. The pipeline checks this at launch and lists what is missing. The simplest valid directory is what a run without this parameter saves to ./vaximile_resources/bwa_index/.

star_index.description: Directory containing a prebuilt STAR index. When not given, the index is built and saved to vaximile_resources/star_index/STARGenomeDir/ in the launch directory.

salmon_index.description: Directory containing a prebuilt salmon index. When not given, the index is built and saved under vaximile_resources/salmon_index/ in the launch directory.

downloaded_resource_options.title: Downloaded resource options
downloaded_resource_options.description: Resources the pipeline downloads when not given, once, into ./vaximile_resources/ in the launch directory, reusing them on later runs.

vep_cache.description: Path to a local Ensembl VEP cache directory. Optional; downloaded if omitted.
vep_cache.help_text: Leave unset and the pipeline pulls the release-115 GRCh38 human cache (~24 GiB) from https://ftp.ensembl.org/pub/release-115/variation/indexed_vep_cache/ into ./vaximile_resources/vep_cache, reusing it on later runs. Supply this only to point at a cache you already have, or to run against an assembly or species other than human GRCh38 - the release must be 115 to match the VEP the pipeline runs.

vep_plugins.description: Directory containing the pVACtools Frameshift.pm and Wildtype.pm VEP plugins. Downloaded if omitted.
vep_plugins.help_text: Leave unset and the pipeline downloads the plugins for the pVACtools version it runs (7.1.5) into ./vaximile_resources/vep_pvac_plugins. Plugins from another pVACtools version may not match the pVACseq it runs.

ctat_resource_lib.description: CTAT genome library for STAR-Fusion: the ctat_genome_lib_build_dir directory of a plug-n-play bundle. Downloaded if omitted.
ctat_resource_lib.help_text: Leave unset and the pipeline downloads the GRCh38 GENCODE v44 plug-n-play bundle (Oct 29 2023) into ./vaximile_resources/ctat_resource_dir.

arriba_blacklist.description: Arriba blacklist. Downloaded with the Arriba v2.5.1 release if omitted.

arriba_known_fusions.description: Arriba known fusions. Downloaded with the Arriba v2.5.1 release if omitted.

arriba_protein_domains.description: Arriba protein domains (GFF3). Downloaded with the Arriba v2.5.1 release if omitted.

ascat_resources.description: Directory of ASCAT 1000 Genomes resources: G1000_loci_hg38/, G1000_alleles_hg38/, GC_G1000_hg38/ and RT_G1000_hg38/. Downloaded if omitted.
ascat_resources.help_text: Laid out as the pipeline downloads them into ./vaximile_resources/ascat_hg38_chr (or ascat_hg38_nochr), so a previous run's folder can be given directly. The loci files' contig names must match the reference, which is why the download adds a chr prefix when --reference_includes_chr_prefix is set.

variant_calling_options.title: Variant calling options
variant_calling_options.description: Interval scattering behaviour for the GATK-based callers.

interval_padding.description: Bases of padding added around each calling interval.

scatter_count.description: Number of interval shards to scatter variant calling across.

hla_typing_options.title: HLA typing options
hla_typing_options.description: Reference data for MHC region extraction and HLA allele calling.

hla_fasta_fai.description: Index for the HLA reference FASTA.

hla_kmers.description: Unique HLA k-mer file used by the typing tools.

novoalign_dir.description: Directory containing the novoalign and novoindex binaries, needed for HLA LOH. Without it, HLA LOH is skipped.
novoalign_dir.help_text: Novoalign is proprietary and was removed from bioconda in October 2026 at Novocraft's request, so the pipeline cannot install it. Download it from https://www.novocraft.com/support/download/. Novoalign V4 also needs its novoalign.lic licence file in the same directory; V3 runs without one, single-threaded. Without this parameter mhcflow, the tumor realignment and lohhlamod are skipped; HLA typing with OptiType and HLA-HD still runs.

gatk_resource_options.title: GATK resource bundle options
gatk_resource_options.description: Known-sites VCFs used for BQSR, contamination estimation and somatic filtering. Each must have a matching .tbi.

common_germline.description: Common germline biallelic SNP sites for contamination estimation.

known_sites_dbsnp.description: dbSNP known sites VCF for BQSR.

pon.description: Panel of normals VCF for Mutect2.

hapmap.description: HapMap VCF for germline variant recalibration.

somalier_sites.description: Sites VCF used by somalier for relatedness checks.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.

publish_dir_mode.description: Method used to save pipeline results to output directory.
